zh_cn: 本版本使用数据组件：nbt 是 minecraft:custom_data 的 SNBT；components 对象指定其他组件，例如 {"minecraft:potion_contents":{"potion":"minecraft:water"}}。配方精确匹配完整组件，return 也支持 components。metadata 仅表示损伤值。
以 _ 开头的文件只作示例，不会加载。复制为其他名称并设置 enabled 为 true 后，重启游戏或服务器加载。
每个文件定义一种独立调味粉；id 必须唯一且使用 命名空间:名称 格式，不要改动已经投入使用的 id。
color 为 #RRGGBB。translations 按语言代码填写名称 name、食物前缀 prefix、后缀 suffix；前后缀可以为空，名称与食物之间自动加空格。未配置当前语言时优先使用 en_us，然后使用已配置语言。
translations 的各语言可填写 tooltip 字符串，用 \n 换行；填写后替代自动的名称及药水说明，省略或留空则保留自动说明。单粉、混合粉和调味食物共用此文案，各行沿用该粉颜色，混合重复仍附加足量或致死量提示；不影响实际药水效果及食物的药水效果提示。
recipes 中可以有多条研磨配方；每条使用一种原料，input.count 是投入数量，output_count 是产出粉末数量，每批仍需三秒。原料可指定 metadata 和 SNBT 字符串 nbt；不指定 nbt 时只匹配不带 NBT 的原料。
投入数不得超过原料最大堆叠，产出数为1到64。相同原料及NBT不能同时对应多种配方，冲突或物品/药水缺失的整个文件会跳过，日志会说明原因。
原料容器默认返还（水桶返空桶，药水瓶返玻璃瓶）；可在配方中添加 return 物品对象（item、metadata、count、nbt）指定每个原料的返还物，return:null 表示不返还。返还物先尝试送入下方已识别的抽取器，剩余掉落。
effects 的1、2、3分别表示粉末在调味中出现一份、两份、三份时的完整效果列表；三档独立填写，不自动增强。空数组表示该档没有药水效果。可以填写多个不同效果。
potion 为原版或模组药水注册名，level 从1开始（1为Ⅰ），duration_seconds 为持续秒数（允许小数，最少0.05秒）。自定义粉可与内置粉混合，所有混合粉仍共用一个混合口味。
同一种药水与原食物效果合并时，时长相加、等级取较高；重复食用刷新而不无限累加玩家已有时长。diversity_multiplier 默认1.2，只影响多样性，不改变美食阅历基础收益。
有效自定义粉会出现在创造物品栏、食物书未尝口味、JEI/EMI研磨和混合配方中；服务器会同步名称、颜色和效果，客户端不需要复制此JSON。
可额外填写 effects.4、effects.5 等更高份数档；未填写的高档从第三档继续增强等级或按时长倍率外推。重复修饰只显示至第三档，食物药水行显示实际效果。药水等级最高256，时长最多2147483647刻。
en_us: This version uses data components: nbt is SNBT for minecraft:custom_data; components specifies other components, e.g. {"minecraft:potion_contents":{"potion":"minecraft:water"}}. Recipes match all components exactly; return also accepts components. metadata means damage only.
Files starting with _ are examples and are not loaded. Copy to another filename, set enabled to true, and restart the game/server.
Each file defines one spice with a unique namespace:path ID. Keep IDs stable after use.

color uses #RRGGBB. translations maps language codes to name, food prefix and suffix; empty affixes are allowed. Spaces around the food name are automatic. Missing languages fall back to en_us, then another configured language.

Each translation may include a tooltip string with \n line breaks. It replaces the automatic name/effect description; omitted or blank text keeps the automatic description. Powders, blends and seasoned foods share this text, colored per spice on every line. Repeated copies still append Lots or Too Much. Actual effects and food potion tooltips are unchanged.

recipes supports multiple grinding recipes, each with one ingredient: input.count consumed and output_count produced per three-second batch. Optional metadata and SNBT string nbt select the exact stack; omitted nbt matches only stacks without NBT.
Input counts must fit the ingredient stack limit; output counts range from 1 to 64. Conflicting ingredients/NBT or missing items/potions reject the entire file, with a reason in the log.

Containers are returned automatically (empty buckets and glass potion bottles). Optional return stack (item, metadata, count, nbt) overrides the return per input item; return:null disables returns. Recognized bottom collectors receive containers first; leftovers drop.
effects keys 1, 2 and 3 specify complete, independent effect lists for that many copies in a seasoning. No automatic scaling is applied. [] gives no effects; multiple distinct effects are allowed.

potion is a vanilla/mod registry ID; level starts at 1 (I); duration_seconds is in seconds (fractions allowed, minimum 0.05). Custom spices mix with built-ins; all blends still share one mixed dietary flavor.

Matching food effects combine by adding duration and taking the higher level. Repeated meals refresh rather than accumulate existing player durations. diversity_multiplier defaults to 1.2 and affects diversity only.
Valid spices appear in creative inventory, untasted flavors, JEI/EMI grinding and mixing. Definitions are synced by the server; clients do not need a copy of the JSON.

Optional effects.4, effects.5 and higher tiers specify exact effects. Missing higher tiers extrapolate levels or duration from tier 3. Repeat descriptions stop at tier 3; food potion lines show the actual effects. Levels cap at 256 and durations at 2147483647 ticks.
